intro: Interlock, Rhysida, and ShinyHunters were the top threat actors targeting the healthcare sector in a series of nine high-severity incidents reported between April 12 and April 30, 2026. The attacks affected critical infrastructure, government, and research sectors, with victims spanning the United States, Global, Illinois, Moldova, and the Netherlands. The severity mix included one medium and eight high-severity events, underscoring the concentrated risk to healthcare organizations during this period.
